parsed_response.rationale:
The current low-level goals (LLGs) comprehensively cover the parent high-level goal (HLG) 'Ensure transparent and traceable product sourcing'. Each LLG represents a distinct, documented functional interaction or effect that supports the customer in making informed purchasing decisions. The LLGs include viewing product origin details, browsing and comparing farmer offers, placing orders with minimum quantity constraints, modifying orders due to availability issues using precedence and fair-play rules, reviewing and accepting modified orders, and canceling orders when all products are unavailable with notification.

The LLGs are supported by documentary evidence in the project description. They accurately reflect the system's capabilities without redundancy or omission. Each LLG represents a unique aspect of the customer's interaction with the system, from initial product exploration to final order management. The LLGs also account for potential availability issues and their resolution through precedence rules and fair-play scoring.

There are no unsupported or misleading LLGs, nor any essential capabilities missing from this decomposition. All documented parent capabilities have corresponding children, and there is no duplication of functionality.
